title: Working Library - Inventor to Revit Exchange

entries.name: RVT target
entries.use_when: assembly is primarily needed for coordination, spatial context, linking, or model-package exchange
working_guidance: preserve a stable output location and identity

entries.name: RFA target
entries.use_when: object should behave as a reusable Revit component with category control and possibly connectors
working_guidance: add connectors only where system participation requires them

entries.name: BIM simplification strategy
working_guidance: suppress small manufacturing hardware that adds no BIM value
suppress internal manufacturing detail not needed downstream
prefer outer envelope plus key interfaces
use named model states or equivalent controlled representations

candidate_values.preset: No simplification after representation has already been simplified

entries.name: Revit-side validation
checks: update path works where update behavior is required

working_rules: Do not publish manufacturing-heavy geometry into Revit by default.
RVT versus RFA is an intent decision, not merely a file-format preference.
A controlled export representation is preferred over an arbitrary current view/state.
Export settings remain candidates until verified for the current tool versions and project requirements.

provenance.migration_note: Inventor-to-Revit publishing workflow retained as non-authoritative working knowledge; source organization naming removed.
